nodes.label: DSDesign Swift package (iOS 26, Swift 6): tokens and SwiftUI components
nodes.rationale: iOS half of the Quiet Paper design system; web counterpart is packages/ui; owned by the design-system stream (D-39)

nodes.label: Tokens.generated.swift (generated, do not edit by hand)
design-tokens contract (docs/architecture/contracts/design-tokens.md)
nodes.rationale: Token names are a contract; token values are only PROPOSED

nodes.label: pnpm design-tokens generate / check (CI: generated equals committed)
SwiftUI token API (dsFont, .ds colors, dsTint, ink, dsShadow, withDSAnimation, DSHaptics)
nodes.rationale: Semantic colors adapt to light/dark theme; pen inks are lightened in dark theme; fonts use New York with Dynamic Type

nodes.label: DSBackdrop / DSGrain (gradient backdrops with paper grain)
DSSpaceTile (space/notebook tile: emoji or letter on its tint)
DSCard / DSDocCard (cover thumbnail only from own image, spec 12.7)
DSDocRow / DSDocIcon / DSDocGrid (document list row and adaptive card grid)
DSPenMode flat pen mode (text / pen / pencil / marker / highlighter / strokeEraser / pixelEraser / lasso)
DSShowcase (all components; previews, debug screen, CI snapshots)
DSDateChipModel date rules (Today / Tomorrow / date, red when overdue, ru/en)
nodes.rationale: Date rules match the web (packages/ui/src/lib/date.ts): same labels and tones, shared test cases

nodes.label: iOS pen palette model (text mode tool==nil, pen/pencil/marker/highlighter/eraser/lasso, width steps 1/2/3 = 0.6/1/1.6 of base, stroke/pixel eraser, finger drawing, undo/redo)
#Preview for every component in light and dark theme
CI design.yml (macOS): build, Swift Testing, DSShowcase PNG snapshots (dsdesign-snapshots)
nodes.rationale: Snapshots in light and dark theme let the design be reviewed without a Mac
